CheckTitle: Inline Policies allow full access to KMS
Description: IAM roles or users have been observed with inline policies attached that allow full "*" access to KMS (Key Management Service).
Risk: Granting full access to KMS may result in data exposure, key deletion, or modified key policies and grants.

Recommendation.Text: Consider limiting access to resources in accordance with the principle of least privilege, and avoid making use of wildcards on policy declarations.
